stem: Two seed lots are germinated under the same documented conditions. Lot A reaches 92% normal emergence while Lot B reaches 48%. What is the strongest next step?
choices: Change conditions only for Lot A.
Record lot identity and repeat/confirm the comparison before treating both lots as equivalent.
Combine the lots so their average emergence is acceptable.
Assume every non-emerged seed was planted upside down.
rationale: Lot-level traceability and repeated controlled comparisons help distinguish seed-lot viability differences from environmental or handling effects.
